title: The Hunt Brothers' Silver Squeeze of 1980: What Happened and What Investors Learn
description: In 1980, two brothers accumulated 100 million ounces of silver and drove prices to $49.45/oz. Here's the full story of Silver Thursday and what it means for silver investors today.
alt: Silver price chart showing the Hunt Brothers squeeze peak of $49.45 per ounce in January 1980 and the Silver Thursday collapse to $10.80
